dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔

Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Unbelievable... I make myself my first-ever Kindred, without authorization at that, and... it's this bumbling fool...?
真烦啊……我未经允许制作的第一名眷属，竟然是这么劣等的家伙……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
I pray for your forgiveness... Father...
我祈求您的原谅……父亲啊……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
... Begone from my sight. At least thou hast brought me Bloodbags for sustenance...
……退下吧。幸好还能为我运来血袋……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Yet, it must be the responsibility of a parent to clean up the mess of his child...
子嗣的丑态应由其亲族负责……

What a load of shit.
鬼扯。

With that, Cassetti reached out toward the pile of Bloodbags on the ground, and...
说完话之后，卡塞蒂向倒地的血袋们伸出了手……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Haah... Oh, abundance... what an unfamiliar sensation you'd become...
呼……久违的、几近遗忘的饱腹之感……

An armor of hardened blood materialized over the Bloodfiend's body; his sheer aggression and hatred was palpable enough to make our skin crawl.
凝固的血液将他的全身武装了起来，向我们展示着足以令人全身发麻的强大敌意。

... It appears that he has empowered himself by reaping their blood.
……他看上去似乎是通过收集血液来增强自己的力量。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Though my power is yet to fully return... This magnificent armor is quite befitting of this risen king's Parade... Wouldst thou agree? Yessir, yes you do! 'Course you do!
虽然力量尚未完全恢复……但这种程度，正与已然成王的我之游行相称……你不这么认为吗？！

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Challenge me now, O rebels! Challenge thy king!
来吧！挑战我吧！妄图加害于王的反叛者们！
